subject: Stellar Retail — renewal + capacity uplift coordination

Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Stellar Retail — renewal + capacity uplift coordination

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the time last week. I pulled together the usage snapshots and a short playbook for the upcoming renewal. Quick summary up front: Stellar is tracking ~3.2B tokens/month for the last 90 days with a 34% month-over-month uplift driven by the new product search reranker roll-out. Peak p95 latency on the hosted model is 180ms; when you burst to dedicated endpoints we see p95 near 75ms.

Options I recommend for the renewal:
- 18-month commit (preferred): smooths unit price across the uplift and gives you burst credits for holiday peaks
- Add a dedicated pool for the reranker (1–2 GPUs) with autoscale rules; expected cost improvement ~22% per 1M tokens vs hosted during steady-state because we can leverage batching + KV cache
- Interim: 3-month bridge (burst credits) if procurement needs more time

Next steps: I can share a concise ROI packet and the amendment draft. If procurement wants a different term we can model the unit economics quickly. Ben will attach the Q3 performance report for your ops team to review.

Would Wednesday 11/17 at 10am PT work for a short sync with Procurement + Ops to lock SLOs and the amendment timeline?

Best,
Marissa

--

Marissa —

Appreciate the summary. The token numbers line up with what we see on our end — the reranker rollout drove most of the lift in October. A couple quick asks from Ops/Procurement:

1) Can you quantify the expected latency improvement and cost delta if we move the reranker to a dedicated pool vs staying on hosted (we need a clear per-1M token cost comparison)?
2) Procurement prefers not to exceed 12 months by default — open to 18 if the economics make sense and there are clear exit/flex provisions.
3) We need the SOC2 docs and a short summary of retention/audit log options for the dedicated setup to share with security.

We can do the Wed 11/17 10am PT slot — I'll loop Elena (ops) and procurement.

Thanks,
Tom

Tom / team —

Attaching the Q3 inference performance packet (Stellar_Q3_inference_report.pdf) and a short heatmap (latency_heatmap_Q3.png). Highlights:
- Aggregate token consumption: 3.1B (Jul) -> 3.7B (Oct); Oct spike attributed to reranker A/B rollout (traffic slice).
- Cost delta model (hosted vs dedicated dedicated for reranker):
  * Hosted (current): ~$0.26 per 1k tokens (effective, includes mixed model usage)
  * Dedicated (2xA10 pool, caching + batching): ~$0.20 per 1k tokens steady-state; with autoscale to handle peaks effective blended ~$0.22 per 1k tokens over the month
  * Net improvement: ~15–22% per-token depending on burst frequency and cache hit rate.
- Latency: p50/p95 on hosted for reranker: 48ms / 180ms. Dedicated pool brings p50/p95 to 26ms / 75ms in our tests.
- Quality: no degradation observed after quantization for the reranker (we ran 500-query sampling).

Security & retention: SOC2 Type II is available (link below). For dedicated we support 90/365 day retention buckets and exportable audit logs; we can map to Stellar's retention policy in the amendment.

I'll bring the slides into the Wed sync and walk ops through the heatmap.

Attachments: Stellar_Q3_inference_report.pdf, latency_heatmap_Q3.png

Ben

Subject: Re: Stellar Retail — renewal + capacity uplift coordination

Tom / Elena / Procurement —

Great sync this morning. Two items I want to be explicit about from Redwood's side so Procurement has clarity:

1) Pricing construct: We can offer an 18-month committed discount tier that reduces the per-1k token rate by an additional 8% on top of the dedicated steady-state pricing Ben shared, but we require an annual true-up clause (standard). If 18 months is unacceptable we can model a 12-month with a slightly smaller uplift (approx +4% vs reported steady-state).

2) Exit/flex provisions: For the 18-month amendment we include a 60-day notice window to downsize capacity tiers at each 6-month checkpoint (to avoid overcommitment). We will also provision 50% burst credits for the first 90 days post-commitment to cover migration traffic.

Marissa — can you send the amendment draft (amendment_18mo_v2.docx) and a quick one-page ROI that shows projected savings at current token growth rates?

Thanks,
Karthik

Marissa / Karthik —

Procurement and legal reviewed the amendment draft. We appreciate the burst credits and the 6-month checkpoints. A few clarifying asks before routing to signatures:

1) Please add explicit SLO language for p95 latency for the dedicated reranker (target: <=100ms) and an SLA credit table tied to p95 breaches.
2) We need SOC2 evidence link and the retention mapping clause updated to show 90-day audit log availability and a 365-day cold archive export option.
3) Confirm the effective per-1k token blended rate under the 18-month with the 50% burst credit applied for Q1 of the term.

If you can confirm these three items and re-upload the updated DocuSign package by COB 11/20 we can proceed with signature the following week.

Procurement
Stellar Retail
